name: credit-tracker
description: Self-hosted personal app that tracks unused credit-card statement credits via Stripe Financial Connections, Plaid, Teller, or CSV.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n worker,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:legacy: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client:legacy"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix worker install
